prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic high-fashion harvest portrait of an adult woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness exactly without celebrity or public-figure substitution. Frame her in a medium shot angled slightly to one side, delicately holding a woven artisan basket of freshly picked strawberries against her hip. She wears a voluminous asymmetrical dark-red floral silk-organza gown cinched with a raw distressed black leather belt, layered thin gold necklaces, and a prominent crystal strawberry pendant. Her hair is a messy voluminous textured updo with wind-swept tendrils; makeup is minimalist with matte natural skin, sharp mascara, and softly flushed cheeks. Place her in an open strawberry field under a dramatic overcast sky with thick fog. Use hard off-camera strobe rim light to define her silhouette and translucent organza. Shoot on an 85mm lens with stylized 35mm film grain, natural skin texture, vertical 2:3 framing, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, identity blending, celebrity likeness, watermark, readable text, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
